procedure: Header strips rendered with pdfplumber page.crop(...).to_image(resolution=300) from prose_end=130 to find_table_top()+36; ambiguous cells zoomed at 600 dpi. Labels read left-to-right per page.
structure_note: One logical 21-column table (20 precincts + TOTAL) paginated as row-blocks with column-halves: p2/p3 = row block 1 (p2 = columns 1-11, p3 = columns 12-20 + TOTAL), p4/p5 = row block 2 (p4 = columns 1-11, p5 = columns 12-20 + TOTAL). Column sets repeat; row sums reconcile across halves (e.g. Malski 4343+3286=7629).
truncation_note: King's Chapel, Central Maintenance, Hillcrest Church, Pleasant Ridge: page-edge/clipping truncations in the 2026 general recap; full names taken from the same county's 2026 primary precinct file (20260310__ms__primary__union__precinct.csv), whose printed names match every truncated prefix (Central Maintenance also in the 2024 general Union file).
